title: Video by earn.edits
description:
This transition wasn’t built by hand — an AI agent did it. 🤯✨

I uploaded a reference I liked, added my own clips, and just told the agent to recreate that transition across every shot. It took it from there — applied it to my footage and built it directly on an editable timeline. 🎬🔁

No manually matching frame by frame. Just described what I wanted and let it work. 🗣️🤖

invideo Editor is completely free 🆓🚀

Comment “invideo” and I’ll send you the link to sign up 👇
